tests/app-browser-workflows.mjs.reason: Reaches the permission-denial step: Chromium started through Playwright does not apply the browser permission override in this context (expected denied, got granted). The unmodified baseline fails at the same step with the same message.

tests/erp-sales-browser.mjs.reason: Needs the original ERP workbook (ENOENT /home/upload/Reports_Invoices_14480422_094904.xlsx); it was never supplied. The unmodified baseline fails identically.

tests/offline-browser.mjs.reason: Cold offline reload: Playwright setOffline does not cover the service worker network in this Chromium. The unmodified baseline times out at the same wait (locator.waitFor, 18000 ms).

tests/pwa-browser.mjs.reason: Cold offline navigation uses the data-free client shell: same cause as offline-browser. The unmodified baseline fails at the same assertion.

gates.browserNotes: Four tests fail exactly as before this update and as on the base commit, at the same step, for the same reasons (Playwright cannot deny a permission or work offline in this Chromium, and the original ERP workbook is not available here); the twenty-one others pass, among them the new build-notice-browser (16 checks) and mobile-comfort-browser (207).
